limitations: Controlled committed-forward barriers prove ownership/skip/parity, not native-kernel arrival timestamps or hard interruption bounds.
The cooperative probe observes closure of nine forwarded/recovery images per model; deterministic regressions additionally check all prepared images.
Skipped native images may already have been fetched/decoded. Existing remote children settle/reap before the next checkpoint.
Incomplete cancelled batches have unknown full-batch parity and are never successful throughput.
Finite synthetic square and poster/landscape/codec profiles on a shared host; sequential chunk comparisons are not a controlled speedup or production percentile.
Process RSS, shared whole-cgroup charging and device-wide free memory have different scopes. Do not subtract independent peaks or replace prior cold-export sizing.
Mixed-input experiments explicitly use API batch size 8; representative profiles retain API size 32, one caller and the 45-second deadline.
No new physical ARM, legacy NVIDIA, Intel GPU, hosted Windows/Actions or external client-address preservation result is claimed.
Scoped analysis/audits do not constitute a full repository security audit.
